semiconductor_relevance: High — Microtest provides advanced testing products and services specifically for the semiconductor ecosystem, focusing on power semiconductor testing.
summary: Microtest offers best-in-class Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) and test services tailored for the semiconductor industry, particularly in the automotive, industrial, power, sensor, and healthcare markets. With over 25 years of experience, they focus on optimizing business operations and reducing testing costs through innovative solutions.
capabilities: VIP Ultra high-throughput ATE for Si, SiC, and GaN power devices
Comprehensive suite of DC and energy-stress test capabilities
Configurable ATE for high side and low side Driver ICs, IGBT, Power MOSFETs, and Power ICs

regional_presence.Italy: Microtest is headquartered in Italy and provides global support.
